fact: Kenya News Agency reports that on 20 July 2025 Kenya and Tanzania ministers launched at the Lunga Lunga/Horohoro border a cross-border project joining Kenya's national broadband backbone and submarine cable infrastructure with Tanzania's, implemented by Kenya's ICT Authority and TTCL; it does not say the link is lit.
Connecting Africa reports that in July 2025 TTCL and Kenya's ICT Authority launched and implemented a terrestrial fibre link connecting Dar es Salaam in Tanzania to Mombasa in Kenya.
